**Misc**

| Field Name | Description |
|---|---|
| Repo Margin Suf | Indicates the suffix for the repo counterparty margin portfolio. The value in this field determines the portfolios used for the reporting of REPO, stock or borrow lending contracts. |
| Rp Mrgn | Indicates the description of the Repo Margin Suf field. |
| Reso Margin Suf | Indicates the suffix for the reverse repo counterparty margin portfolio. The value in this field determines the portfolios used for the reporting of RESO contracts. |
| Rs Mrgn | Indicates the description of the Reso Margin Suf field. |
| Init Mrgn Booking | Indicates the initial margin of a REPO contract, which undervalues the securities involved to cover the risk of the adverse movement of the securities, which may arise before a margin call. The values are: Notional - Included in the margin portfolio valuation None – Display-only. |
| Repo Limit Update | Indicates whether the limit for a REPO contract is regarded as a LOAN or DEPOSIT. |
| Days Post Maturity | Indicates the number of days after maturity the contract remains in the live table. After this period expires, the matured contract is moved to the history table during the COB processing. The SBL contracts with zero nominal are moved to history after a specified period. However, if the contract is amended prior to this date, the nominal is increased to a non-zero value. The contract remains in the LIVE table until the specified time, as the nominal is again reduced to zero and the number of days specified is exceeded after restarting the day’s count. Once a contract is moved to the HISTORY table, it is not possible to restore the contract to a live contract. The contacts with zero nominal are not included in calculating corporate action for the stock concerned, unless there is an outstanding settlement. |
| Calculation Link | Indicates the default copied into each REPO record as it is created and determines if there are links between certain fields during the creation of the REPO contract. |
| Auto Calc Nominal | Indicates the cash amount entered in Principal Amount and any initial margin and calculates the amount of nominal required to exceed the cash amount if this field is set to Yes and the Trans Type field is set to Cash. This field is mandatory if the Calculation Link field is set to Yes. |
| Update Sc Pos Sod | Indicates that the REPO contract generates the near leg SECURITY.TRANSFER record immediately on authorising the contract regardless of the value date if this field is set to Yes. .In addition, this field updates the SECURITY.POSITION because of the far leg of the SECURITY.TRANSFER , at the SOD of the maturity date instead of the COB of the maturity date as occurred so far. This is a display-only field |
| Process Repo Sod | Indicates if the forward dated REPO contracts become LIVE and the maturity of the REPO contracts. The contracts can be processed either the SOD or COB. The values are Null, Fwd To Live, Maturity or Both. If this field is set to Null, the transactions turn live or mature at COB. This field enables selective process of the contracts becoming live or maturing at SOD. If the Update Sc Pos Sod field is set to Yes, this field accepts only the values Maturity or Both. |
| Ent Cpn Susp | Indicates if the RESO entries are posted to this specific account for corporate actions. This field allows the user to change the Account No field in the ENTITLEMENT record for the RESO positions. |
| Split Debit Cpn | Indicates if the cash entries relating to REPO contracts are posted to separate Nostro account. This process is enabled if the Account field is updated for the REPO application in the NOSTRO.ACCOUNT record. The NOSTRO.ACCOUNT record must be entered in the security currency of the DIARY. |
| Ac Block Clos Updt | Indicates if the Ac Block Closure from the REPO application is automatically updated for field New Cu Acct No in REPO. If this field is set to No, updates are not made and the ACCOUNT.CLOSURE application closes the accounts in live REPO contracts. |
| Accrue Fee | Indicates the fee that accrues until the contract matures for fixed term or until closed out for open trades, if this field is set to Yes. If value date is selected in charge frequency, the default is not to accrue. The fee amount posted on the repo contract accrues on a daily basis with the initial fee based on the current market value of the contract. After the first day, fee needs to be calculated based on the price stored on the SECURITY.MASTER and a COB should be run with the SECURITY.MASTER price being changed prior to the COB to ensure the accrual amount is correct. |
| Stp | Allows auto STP creation of the opposite SBL Internal Trade, if this field is set to Yes. This field can be set to Yes or left blank. |
| Fee Refund | Indicates the required refund of the fees, if the fee was taken on value date. For a fixed term contract the user can early mature the trade, if required. This is a Yes or No field. |

**Misc**

| S.No | Product Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | REPO | A REPO is an agreement of sale and repurchase of a security. The securities are sold to the counterparty at a fixed price and the seller has a commitment to repurchase those securities at a pre-agreed price at a fixed point of time in the future. The price difference can be seen as the interest to deposit and maybe defined as a cash price or as a repo rate. |
| 2 | Reverse REPO(RESO) | A RESO is an agreement of purchase and re-sale of a security, which is also a converse of a REPO agreement. The securities are purchased at a fixed price and the buyer has the commitment to re-sale those securities at a pre-agreed price at a future date. The price difference can be seen as interest to the loan and maybe defined as price. |
| 3 | Sell-Buy Back | A sell or buy back is an agreement of a spot sale and a forward repurchase of a security. This is different from REPO agreement as the sale and purchase are treated as two separate legs. Hence, an agreement is not required. |
| 4 | Buy-Sell Back | A buy or sell back is an agreement of a spot purchase and a forward sale of a security. This is different to REPO agreement as the purchase and sale are treated as two separate legs. Hence, an agreement is not required. |

**REPO Contract**

| Field Name | Description |
|---|---|
| REPO Type | Determines the type of REPO contract to be entered. It must be a valid record in the REPO .TYPE application. |
| Counterparty | Initiates the REPO contract when this field is blank. It must be a valid record on the CUSTOMER and CUSTOMER.SECURITY applications. |
| Currency | Indicates the currency of the REPO contract. It must be a valid record in the CURRENCY application. |
| Business Centre | Determine the working days for a specific country. It must be a valid record in the COUNTRY application. |
| Trade Date | Indicates the date on which the trade was agreed. It defaults to the current date. |
| Value Date | Indicates the date on which the contract becomes active |
| Maturity Date | Indicates the date on which the REPO contract matures. If the value in the REPO Type is set to Open REPO, it allows a value of 0 (zero), which can be changed to a valid maturity date. |
| Principal Amount 1 | Specifies the total amount of the contract on the near leg. |
| Principal Amount 2 | Specifies the total amount of the contract on the far leg |
| Interest Basis | Specifies the interest basis which is used for calculating interest. It allows entry of A-F and S (for special allows the user to modify the REPO Interest field) from the INTEREST.BASIS application (read comments below this table for more information). |
| REPO Rate | Sets the rate at which the REPO accrues the interest during the life of the contract. It is used to calculate the Principa l Amount 2 field. A negative REPO rate can be entered if required. |
| Product Category | Defaults the value from the REPO .TYPE record but may be changed manually in which case it must be a valid record in the CATEGORY application |
| Agreement Type | Specifies the agreement type that adheres to both legs of the contract. It must be a valid record in the REPO .AGREEMENT.TYPE application. |
| Condition | Accepts free format text. In this field, special conditions that apply to this contract are entered. |
| Limit Reference | Defaults the value from the LIMIT.REFERENCE application |
| Deal Type | Indicates the type of deal represented by this contract: Bilateral - Involves two parties. Trilateral - Involves three parties. |
| Prin Increase | Makes a margin call in cash. The amount of cash to be received or paid out for purposes of margin must be entered in this field. The margin call is effective from the date mentioned in the Mgn Call Eff Date field. After this, the field is made null. |
| Prin Increase Int | Displays the change in the REPO interest on account of the change in the principal resulting from a cash margin call. This is a no input field. |
| Mgn Call Eff Date | Holds the date on which the margin call comes into effect. The effective date must fall between the Value Date and the Maturity Date of the contract. The user may input a back valued date provided it falls between the Value Date and the Maturity Date of the contract. The Mgn Call Eff Date field becomes mandatory, if there is a value in the Pri Increase field, or a change made to the New Sec Code or New Nominals fields in an authorised record. |
| Send Payment | Determines whether any delivery message is to be sent for the change in the principal. If this field is set to YES, delivery instructions are generated to pay or receive cash. The default value for this field is NO. |
| Proj Cash Amt | Displays the revised principal on account of the margin call in the Proj Cash Amt field till the margin call takes effect, If the value in the Mgn Call Eff Date is a future date |
| New Sec Code | Determines the security that is used in the REPO contract. Once the record is authorised, if this field is changed it effects a substitution. |
| New Nominal | Determines the amount of the security that is traded in this REPO contract |
| Clean Price | Defaults the value from the Last Price field in the SECURITY.MASTER record. It can be manually changed in which case the values in the Gross Amount and Dirty Price fields are recalculated. |
| Gross Amount | Holds the gross amount of the REPO contract |
| Dirty Price | Holds the price which includes the Accrued Int Amt |
| Accrued Int Amt | Holds the accrued coupon interest. The parameters for this calculation are set in the SECURITY.MASTER record. |
| New Depo | Specifies the depository where the security is held |
| Sub Account | Specifies a sub-account for the depository entered in the New Depo field. It must be configured in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application. |
| New Cu Acct No | Defaults the value from either the Margin Portfolio (for regular REPO) or Cust Portfolio (for Customer REPO) fields in the SECURITY.ACC.MASTER record. This field can be modified manually. |
| Sc Init Mgn Rte | Populates the Sc Init Mgn Amt field. It is available only when the Trans Type field is set to SECURITY and is a percentage used to undervalue the securities. |
| Sc Init Mgn Amt | Populates when data is entered in the Sc Init Mgn Rte field |
| Total Settlemnt.1 | Holds the total near leg settlement for the security |
| REPO Interest | Holds the interest to be charged for this security on this contract |
| Fwd Settlemnt | Holds the total far leg settlement for the security |
| Fwd Price | Holds the price that is used for the far leg settlement of the security |
| Cpn Invst Rate | Applies only to buy sell back and sell buy back contracts. It defaults the value from the Repo Rate field and is used to calculate the Cpn Invst Amt . |
| Bnd Rnd Meth | Stores the rounding of method, If the Sc Bond Rounding field is used in the rounding of interest calculations |
| Fx Rate | Defaults the exchange rate from the currency table, where the REPO transaction differs from the security currency. However, the user has the option of changing the rate that has been defaulted. |
| Mgn Deliv Instr | Allows input when a margin call is to be settled in securities. The delivery instructions must always signify a transfer of securities without any associated payment. |
| Supp Delivery | Controls the SWIFT delivery for a complete or partial change in security (substitution). This field in the security multi-value set and has the option YES or NO, Whereas NO is the default value. |
| Newcu Br Xrate | Maps to the Funds Transfer field when making a cash only margin call through the FUNDS.TRANSFER application. It must be only when making a cash margin call and if the account currencies ( New Cu Acct Ccy and Br Account Ccy ) are different.This must only be used if Prin Increase is populated and Funds Transfer is being used for margin calls. |
| Sbl Div Rate | Holds the rate at which the stock borrow or lend transaction takes place |
| Bank Portfolio | Specifies the source of the securities for non-customer REPO contracts |
| Margin Portfolio | Specifies the portfolio to be used for valuations for non-customer REPO contracts |
| Init Margin Rate | Populates the Init Margin Amt field and is available only when the Trans Type is set to CASH and if a percentage is used to undervalue the securities |
| Drawdown Account | Indicates the account across which movements of cash is effected upon the value date of the contract |
| Prin Liq Acct | Identifies the account number where entries are made for the reimbursement of the principal at liquidation or maturity date |
| Prin Ben Bank 1 | Identifies the beneficiary bank that is to be used for the principal amount of a REPO contract at maturity or for a reverse REPO contract. It draws down when the customer has requested for external delivery of the proceeds of the transaction. |
| Prin Ben Bank 2 | Contains the customer reference for the second beneficiary bank for the principal amount, in the case of contracts involving four-party transfers of funds |
| Prin Address | Identifies the full name and address of a beneficiary bank, in respect of the principal amount, where agent details are maintained |
| Benef Prin Acctq | Contains the account details (number or name) of the beneficiary to be credited with the principal amount |
| Int Liq Acct | Identifies the account number where entries are made for the payment of interest. It defaults the value from the Drawdown Account field |
| Int Ben Bank 1 | Identifies the beneficiary bank which is to be used for the payment of the interest amount of deposit contract types, when the customer has requested for external delivery of the interest resulting from the transaction, for the cash side of the REPO contract |
| Int Ben Bank 2 | Contains the customer reference for the interest amount in the second beneficiary bank. This field is used for the cash side of the REPO contract, where contracts involve four party transfers of funds and where disposal of interest on deposits are different from disposal of principal. |
| Int Address | Identifies the full name and address of a beneficiary bank, in respect of the interest amount, when the disposal of the interest is different from the disposal of the principal and where agent details are maintained, for the cash side of the REPO contract |
| Ben Int Address | Identifies the account details (number or name) of the beneficiary to be credited with the interest amount, for the cash side of REPO contract |
| Old Sec Code | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the New Sec Code field |
| Old Nominal | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the New Nominal field |
| Old Clean Price | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the Clean Price field |
| Old Gross Amt | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the Gross Amount field |
| Old Dirty Price | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the Dirty Price field |
| Old Acc Int Amt | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the Accrued Int Amt field |
| Old Depo | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the New Depo field |
| Old Sub Account | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the Sub Account field |
| Old Cu Acct.No | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the New Cu Acct No field |
| Old Mgn Rte | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the Sc Init Mgn Rte field |
| Old Mgn Amt | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the Sc Init Mgn Amt field |
| Old Total Smnt | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the Total Settlemnt.1 field |
| Old REPO Int | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the REPO Interest field |
| Old Fwd Smnt | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the Fwd Settlemnt field |
| Old Fwd Price | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the Fwd Price field |
| Old Bnd Rnd Meth | Populates upon authorisation of the contract and is copied from the Bnd Rnd Meth field |
| Cust Portfolio | Indicates the source portfolio or the portfolio that receives the securities side of the customer REPO contract |
| Broker Depo | Specifies the broker or depository that forms the other side of the customer REPO contract |
| Bank Int Rate | Specifies the bank interest rate for the customer REPO contract |
| Bank Spread Rate | Indicates the difference between the bank interest rate and the customer interest rate (REPO rate), for the customer REPO contract |
| Bank Spread | Indicates the bank's spread, which is calculated using the Bank Spread Rate field |
| Send Notice | Determine whether the corresponding message must be sent or not. This is a multi-value field. The number of multi-values expansion of this field are determined by the number of records on the EB.MESSAGE.CLASS . |
| Trade Time | Records the time when the contract takes place |
| Days Delivery | Specifies the number of working days before the process date, on which a message is to be sent by the Rp Delivery field. If specified, its value is used instead of the value specified in the corresponding Eb Activity field, Days Prior Event |
| Br Account No | Indicates the counterparty account number in order to debit and credit cash |
| Br Account Ccy | Indicates the currency of the Br Account No field, for customer REPO contract and SBB or BSB |
| Tax Amt | Indicates the calculated tax amount based on the interest amount, for customer REPO contract |
| Tax Amt Lcy | Indicates the calculated tax amount based on the interest amount in the local currency, for customer REPO contract |
| Capitalisation | Specifies whether the interest has to be capitalised on a daily basis for the open contracts. This field is defaulted to YES. |
| Mm Int Due Date | Specifies the next interest capitalised cycle. This field is defaulted to DAILY frequency. |
| Calculation Link | Defaults the value from the REPO Type field. It controls how certain fields react with each other. |
| Sc Init Mgn Method | Dictates the calculation method that is used to calculate the initial margin for securities. This field is editable only when the Trans Type field is set to SECURITY. The user can opt for either the STANDARD or GMRA method for this calculation. |
| Trans Type | Determines whether the contract is either SECURITY or CASH driven |
| Mm Locref Name | Indicates the name of a local reference field obtained from the MM.MONEY.MARKET application |
| Mm Locref Data | Populates the local reference field on the MM.MONEY.MARKET application for this contract |
| Str Locref Name | Indicates the name of a local reference field obtained from the SECURITY.TRANSFER application |
| Str Locref Data | The data is required to populate the local reference field on the SECURITY.TRANSFER application for this contract |
| Mature At Sod | Specifies whether REPO must mature at the SOD of the maturity date. It is defaulted to YES, if the Process REPO Sod field in the REPO .PARAMETER application is set to either MATURITY or BOTH. The value in this field is mapped to the Mature At Sod field in the child MM.MONEY.MARKET contract. |
| Country Risk | Assists the asset management module, while determining risk analysis |
| Group Status | Determines if the REPO transaction must be considered for the netting of delivery Instructions. The below values are the available settings for this field: YES NO and NULL For INTERNAL or SBL trades (as set in Rt Deal Type ) this field defaults to NO and cannot be set to NET. |
| Br Agent | Determines the agent (DEAG, DEI1, DEI2..., REAG,REI1,REI2...) in MT540-MT543 messages and forms associated sub value with Br Agent Ac field. This field provides information on instructions to the depository. |
| Br Agent Ac | Determines the agent (DEAG, DEI1, DEI2..., REAG,REI1,REI2...) in MT540-MT543 messages and forms associated sub value with Br Agent field. This field provides information on instructions to the depository. |
| Counterparty Depo | Records which depository the counterparty is using. Any input to this field is mapped to the Broker Depo field in the SECURITY.TRANSFER record.This field is used to create settlement instructions for the clearing systems which has been setup within the Securities module of any particular bank. The value in the Br Def Depo field in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY record of the counterparty, is defaulted in this field provided the depo mentioned in the New Depo field has been setup in the SC.CLEARING.SYSTEM application. |
| Cpty Sec Depo Ac | Records which account number of the depository the counterparty is using. Any input to this field is mapped to the Br Sec Depot Ac field in the SECURITY.TRANSFER record. This field is used to create settlement instructions for clearing systems which has been setup within the Securities module of any particular bank. If The value in the Br Sec Depot Ac field in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY record of the counterparty, is defaulted in this field, provided the depo mentioned in the Counterparty Depo field has been setup in the SC.CLEARING.SYSTEM application. |
| Negative Rate | Defaults to YES, If the value in the Repo Rate field is negative. If the interest rate in the Repo Rate field is positive this field is set to NO. The value in this field is mapped to the Negative Rate field in the MM.MONEY.MARKET application. It is a no-input field. |
| Pset | Determines the place of settlement in MT540-MT543 messages |
| Cancel Mat Call | Cancels an unsettled margin call or maturity instructions.If a margin call was the last action, the associated SECURITY.TRANSFER or FUNDS.TRANSFER contracts are reversed. Whereas, this cannot be cancelled using this field, if a cash margin call has been through the MM.MONEY.MARKET application. If the last action was an entry of a maturity date for an open REPO, the maturity date is reset to 0.It can be YES, only if the last action was either the entry of a maturity date for an open contract or a cash or security margin call. Also, they cannot be cancelled, if the maturing SECURITY.TRANSFER records are generated. |
| Ft Trans Type | Maps to the Transaction Type field in the FUNDS.TRANSFER application. This is used while making a cash margin call using the FUNDS.TRANSFER application. |
| Activity Code | Holds the activity code(s) of the event(s) taking place. This is a multi-value field. |
| Activity Date | Holds the date(s) the activity(s) is or are scheduled for. This is a multi-value field. |
| Mapping Key | Holds the mapping key(s) associated with the message(s) being produced. This is a multi-value field. |
| Msg Ref | Holds reference number(s) of the message(s) produced and returned by APPLICATION.HANDOFF |
| Init Margin Amt | Populates only if the Trans Type is set to CASH and the Init Margin Rate field is set. This is the amount of initial margin that is related to the cash amount entered in the Principal Amount 1 field. |
| Margin Port Suffix | Defaults the value from the REPO .TYPE record. This is the suffix that is used to create the key for the margin portfolio. |
| Broker No | Defaults to the Broker Depo or Counterparty field, for customer REPO |
| Transaction Index | Defaults the value from the REPO .TYPE record |
| Transfer Charges | Ensures that there are no charges on the underlying SECURITY.TRANSFER deals. The transfer of securities under the REPO application are without charge. |
| Delivery Instr | Defaults the value from the REPO .TYPE record, although it can be overwritten with a valid entry in the SC.DEL.INSTR application |
| Sc Trans Type | Defines the transfer type that is used to include a security in the REPO contract and is dependent on the Transaction Index of the REPO .TYPE application used by the transaction. If the REPO contract is a reverse REPO - the Transaction Index , field which uses the transfer type TRI, is set to LOAN. If the REPO contract is REPO - the Transaction Index field, which uses the transfer type TRO, is set to DEPOSIT. |
| Sc Rev Trans Type | Defines the transfer type that is used to remove a security from the REPO contract and is dependant on the Transaction Index of the REPO .TYPE application used by the transaction. If the REPO contract is a reverse REPO - the Transaction Index , field which uses the transfer type TRO, is set to LOAN. If the REPO contract is REPO - the Transaction Index field, which uses the transfer type TRI, is set to DEPOSIT. |
| Interest Amount | Holds the total amount of REPO interest to be charged on this contract |
| Mm Int Basis | Assumes that the same value as the Interest Basis field and is mapped through to the MM.MONEY.MARKET contract |
| Mm Contract Id | Raises a MM.MONEY.MARKET deal, for the cash side of the REPO contract. The key to this deal is held in this field. |
| St Contract Id | Raises a SECURITY.TRANSFER deal for each security detailed on the REPO contract, in order to process the security side of the REPO contract |
| St Reverse Id | Raises a SECURITY.TRANSFER deal for each security detailed on the REPO contract, in order to process the security side of the REPO contract. When a substitution of securities is effected, a SECURITY.TRANSFER deal is raised to back out any securities that have been substituted. When the substitution is authorised, the keys to these contracts are held in this field. |
| St History Id | Raises a SECURITY.TRANSFER deal for each security detailed on the REPO contract, in order to process the security side of the REPO contract. When a substitution of securities is effected, the original transaction references for the SECURITY.TRANSFER deals are held in this field. The transaction references held in this field are no longer a part of the REPO contract and are held purely for information purposes. |
| St Unau Cont Id | Raises SECURITY.TRANSFER deals to effect the movement of the securities, when securities are defined in the REPO contract. The keys to of the SECURITY.TRANSFER deals, whose changes to the security information by the REPO contract are unauthorised, are held in this field. |
| St Unau Rev Id | Raises a SECURITY.TRANSFER deal to back out any securities that have been substituted, when a substitution of securities is effected. When the substitution is unauthorised, the keys to these contracts are held in this field. |
| Contract Status | Holds the current status of the REPO contract, as a three letter code INI - When the value date is in the future, but the delivery instructions for the near leg transfer of securities is issued based on the settings in the REPO .PARAMETER application. FWD - The contract is yet to reach value date. CUR - The contract is current, that is, between value date and maturity date. MAI - Where the maturity date is not reached, but the delivery instructions for the far leg for transfer of securities have been issued based on the settings in the REPO .PARAMETER application. LIQ - The contract has matured. |
| Ft Locref Name | Indicates the name of any local reference field setup in the FUNDS.TRANSFER application. This field forms part of an associated multi-value set along with the Ft Locref Data field. |
| Ft Locref Data | Accepts input of any data that the user may want to input in the local reference field setup in the FUNDS.TRANSFER application. The name of the local reference field appears in the Ft Locref Name field. This field forms part of an associated multi-value set along with the Ft Locref Name field. |
| Ft Margin Id | Contains a multi-valued list of keys of the authorised FUNDS.TRANSFER contracts relating to cash margin calls. This field is used only for cash margin calls when the Generate Ft field in the REPO .TYPE application is set to YES. |
| Rt Deal Type | Populates automatically upon entering a value in the Deal Type field. It contains the value in the Deal Type field in REPO .TYPE application. |
| Cash Hold Settle | Controls cash updates in the SC.SETTLEMENT application. This field allows input of either YES or NO. This field is editable, only if the Actual Settlement field is set to YES and Settle Method is set to US in the SC.PARAMETER record and if the Generate FT field in the REPO .TYPE application is set to YES. If this field is YES, the cash accounting uses the actual settlement. If REPO transaction with Cash Hold Settle field set to YES is authorised, the system creates a SC.SETTLEMENT record from the corresponding SECURITY.TRANSFER transaction. |
| Sec Hold Settle | Control the stock updates in the SC.SETTLEMENT application. This field allows the input of YES or NO. This field is editable, only if the Actual Settlement field is set to YES and Settle Method is set to US in the SC.PARAMETER record and if the Generate FT field in the REPO .TYPE application is set to YES. If REPO transaction with Sec Hold Settle field set to YES is authorised, the system creates a SC.SETTLEMENT record from the corresponding SECURITY.TRANSFER transaction. |
| Cust Act Susp Cat | Captures the suspense amount of the customer. This field is used as a category reference for the customer. The value is picked up from the SC.PARAMETER which holds a similar field in it. The values are defaulted from the SC.PARAMETER fields. The value in this field must be a valid entry in CATEGORY . |
| Brok Act Susp Cat | Captures the suspense amount of the broker. This field is used as a category reference for the broker. The value is picked up from the SC.PARAMETER application, which holds a similar field in it. The values are defaulted from the SC.PARAMETER fields. The value in this field must be a valid entry in CATEGORY . |
| Misc Act Susp Cat | Captures the miscellaneous suspense amount. The value is picked up from the SC.PARAMETER application, which holds a similar field in it. The values are defaulted from the SC.PARAMETER fields. The value in this field must be a valid entry in CATEGORY . |
| Auto Cust Sett | Enables the automatic settlement of the nominal and cash to the customers who have contractual agreements with the bank. This value is defaulted to YES, if the Auto Cust Sett field in CUSTOMER.SECURITY file is set to YES. The automatic settlement can be turned off at transaction level, though it has been turned on in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application. If the Auto Cust Sett field is NULL in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application, this field is defaulted to NO. This field is editable, only if Cash Hold Settle or Sec Hold Settle is set to YES. If Bank Portfolio is a dealer book and the Cash Hold Settle or Sec Hold Settle fields are set to YES this field must be set to YES. This field allows only YES, NO or NULL. Where, NULL is equivalent to NO. |
| Auto Brok Sett | Enables the automatic settlement of the nominal and cash to the brokers who have contractual agreements with the bank. This value is defaulted to YES, if the Auto brok Sett field in CUSTOMER.SECURITY file is set to YES. The automatic settlement can be turned off at transaction level, though it has been turned on in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application. If the Auto brok Sett field is NULL in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application, this field is defaulted to NO. This field is editable, only if Cash Hold Settle or Sec Hold Settle is set to YES. If Bank Portfolio is a dealer book and the Cash Hold Settle or Sec Hold Settle fields are set to YES this field must be set to YES. This field allows only YES, NO or NULL. Where, NULL is equivalent to NO. |
| Intraday Trade | Indicates intra-day REPO deal with same maturity day. System allows both Value date and Repurchase date to be the same. The Start Time and End Time fields are enabled only if this field is set to Yes |
| Start Time | Holds the start time of the REPO intra-day deal. The time format must be HH:MM:SS |
| End Time | Holds the settlement time of the REPO intra-day deal. The input in the End Time field is only allowed when the Start Time field has a value. This field is not mandatory, If set to No , the system calculates interest amount for one full day If set to Yes, the system calculates the duration of the intra-day deal. The time format must be HH:MM:SS |
| Duration | Indicates the duration of the contract in minutes. The system automatically updates this field based on the value in the Start Time and End Time field. The value in this field is rounded “up” to the nearest value |
| Sys Int Amt | Holds the interest amount of the Intra-day Repo contract |

**REPO Contract**

| Field Name | Operation |
|---|---|
| Dep No | Holds the depository number on which there are REPO positions |
| Rp Account | Holds the Nostro account for the REPO entries. It is defaulted from the Account field in the NOSTRO.ACCOUNT record keyed in the security currency, if the Application field is set up to RP. |
| Counterparty | Holds the REPO counterparty portfolio defined in the REPO contract |
| Rp Nominal | Indicates the nominal of the REPO contract with the dealer book |
| Rp Gross Amt | Displays the REPO gross cash amount in the security currency. This amount is the result of the same process of calculation, unlike the one used to process the Entitlement Amt value in ENTITLEMENT record. |
| Rp Net Amt | Displays the REPO net cash amount in the security currency. Rp Net Amt = Rp Gross Amt - (Rp Src Tax + Rp Tot Chgs) |
| Rp Cash Ccy | Indicates the currency of the corporate action |
| Rp Cash Xch | Indicates the exchange rate used between the security currency and the local currency |
| Rp Net Lcy | Indicates the REPO net cash amount in the local currency |

**Stock Borrow or Lending**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Br Account No | Allows the account postings of the required SBL transaction in conjunction with the amended Br Account No field. |
| New Cu Acct No | Controls the account postings for SBL transactions in conjunction with the amended Br Account No field. This functionality is controlled by the following field settings in the REPO.TYPE application: Deal Type - Internal or Stock Borrow Lend Generate FT Transaction - Yes After the user makes these changes, the postings of the required accounting entries are made. The accounting entries to be populated in this field are linked to the portfolio used on the contract and are specified in the SEC.ACC.MASTER application. This field allows all account types and is not restricted to NOSTRO accounts. The updation of this field is controlled by the specific Deal Type used in conjunction with the settings in the SEC.ACC.MASTER application and the account specified in the NOSTRO.ACCOUNT application. |
| Drawdown Account , Prin Liq Acct and Int Liq Acct | If the Generate FT Transaction field in the REPO.TYPE application is set to Yes, these fields become display only fields. |
| Bank Portfolio | Allows the user to define a bank portfolio (own book) or a customer portfolio. |
| Margin Portfolio | Holds the default standard portfolio (-1), which defaults from the Counterparty field. This functionality is driven by the REPO.TYPE application and is available only for internal trades. Also, this functionality is required to ensure if the Security Position of the bank is updated correctly. |
| Group Status | Allows no input in this field and the value is defaulted to No, if the value in the Deal Type field is either Internal or Stock Borrow Lend in the REPO.TYPE application. |

**Stock Borrow or Lending**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Fee | Allows the user to specify the basis points to be used in the calculation of the fee |
| Spread | Allows the spread to be taken into the final calculation of the fee amount and a minus indicates the spread is to be used to reduce the fee |
| Fee Amount | Displays the amount of the fee based on the calculation method. However the user has the option to override this amount to enter an outright fee amount, if required. In the event of an open contract, this field is populated with the daily accrued amount. If the Fee has not been populated, for the customer based on the settings in the FT.COMMISSION.TYPE , Temenos Transact takes the default and populate the Fee Amt field based on this calculation with the option to be overridden at contract level. |
| Chg Freq | Specifies the date to apply the fee amount. The various values that can be given are Value Date: Posts the fee at value date and can only be selected if a flat fee has been populated. No accrual of fee takes place. Maturity Date: Indicates the fee that accrues in the normal way and is posted at the maturity of the contract Periodic Charge: Allows the user to select the charges to be posted either on a (monthly or quarterly or yearly) basis with any outstanding balance be posted at the end of the contract. This option is available for both term and open contracts. Schedule: Allows the user to create a fee schedule record with the same ID as the transaction in RP.FEE.SCHEDULE . The fee amount and payment date are taken from the schedule and are not calculated by the system. |
| Chg Freq Basis | Holds the recycle frequency for accrual of charges |
| Accrual Amt | Records the accrual fee amount. The fee amount posted on the repo contract accrues on a daily basis with the initial fee being based on the current market value of the contract. |
| Accrual Date | Holds the date upto which the amount has been accrued |
| Refund Fee Amt | Records the refund fee amount. The fee is refunded, only if the Fee Refund field is set to yes in REPO.PARAMETER and the contract is fixed term. |
| Fee Day Convention | The fee payment dates for periodic fees is determined based on the value in this field. Null – The actual fee payment date as per frequency is worked out on calendar basis. FOLLOWING – If scheduled date is a holiday, the process date is the next business day PRECEDING – If scheduled date is a holiday, the process date is the preceding business day MODIFIED – If scheduled date is a holiday, the process date is the next business day after the date of the schedule if this date does not fall into the next calendar month. In that case, the process date is the first preceding business day |

**Stock Borrow or Lending**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Start Date | Allows the user to specify the start date of the fee period. This can only be equal to the End Date of the previous period |
| End Date | Allows the user to specify the end date of the period |
| Fee Amt | Allows the user to specify the fee amount for the period. The system accrues fee for this amount and posts the entry for this amount on the payment date. |
| Payment Date | Allows the user to specify the payment date of the fee. Entry for fee is raised on this date. |

**Stock Borrow or Lending**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Accrue Fee | Allows the user to specify whether the fee accrual is required |
| Fee Refund | Allows the user to specify whether fee should be refunded on early closure of the contract |
| Chg Acc Cat | Allows the user to specify the internal account to post the fee accrual |
| Fee Day Convention | The fee payment dates for periodic fees is determined based on the value in this field. The allowed values are: Null – The actual fee payment date as per frequency is worked out on calendar basis. FOLLOWING – If scheduled date is a holiday, the process date is the next business day PRECEDING – If scheduled date is a holiday, the preceding business day MODIFIED – If scheduled date is a holiday, the process date is the next business day after the date of the schedule provided. This date does not fall into the next calendar month and in that case the process date is the first preceding business day This value defaults to Pay Day Convention in REPO application but can be overwritten at the contract level. |
| Fee Day Basis | Allows the user to specify the day basis for fee calculation. Accepts any of the following values: A = 360/360 B = 366/360 C = 366/366 D = 360/366 E = 366/365 F = 360/365 |
| Fee In Percentage | Allows the user to specify whether the fee is given in percentage. If this field is blank, it implies that the fee given in the REPO application is given in basis points (1 basis point equal to 1/100th of 1%). If this field is set to Yes, the fee given is treated as a percentage. |

**Stock Borrow or Lending**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Bw Amt Settled | Stores the borrow amount settled till date and this field is similar to the Cu Amt Settled field |
| Bw Amt Outstand | Stores the borrow amount to be settled and this field is similar to the Cu Nom Outstand field. The value of this field is mapped from the Borrow Amt field in the ENTITLEMENT record. |
| Bw Amt Rec Paid | Captures the customer’s borrow amount being settled, similar to the Cu Amt Rec Paid field |
| Bw Rev Amt | Captures the customer settled borrow amount being reversed, similar to the Cu Reverse Amt field |
| Bw Amt Val Dt | Captures the settlement and reversal date of the borrow amount, similar to the Cu Amt Val Date field |
| Lt Amt Settled | Stores the lend amount settled till date, similar to the Cu Amt Settled field |

| Lt Amt Rec Paid | Captures the customer lending amount being settled, similar to the Cu Amt Rec Paid field |
| Lt Amt Rev | Captures the customer settled lending amount being reversed, similar to the Cu Reverse Amt field |
| Lt Amt Val Dt | Captures the settlement and reversal date for the lending amount, similar to the Cu Amt Val Date field |

**Stock Borrow or Lending**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Cash Hold Settle | Controls whether the cash side of the transaction is settled on an actual or contractual basis. It allows input of Yes if the Delivery Instr field is set to DELIVERY AGAINST PAYMENT. For payment free transactions, this field must be set to No. Depending on the value in the Delivery Instr field, it is determined whether the SC.SETTLEMENT record is built in terms of cash or no cash settlement on an actual basis. |
| Sec Hold Settle | Controls whether the stock side is settled on an actual or contractual basis. If this field is set to Yes, the SECURITY.POSITON recods are updated as per a normal transaction, but with additional updates made to the Unsettled Rp Cr and Unsettled Rp Dr fields with the nominal amount of the transaction. Based on the customer SECURITY.POSITION , for borrow and lend transactions the Unsettled Rp Cr and Unsettled Rp Dr fields are used, respectively. The converse applies for the counterparty SECURITY.POSITIONS . If this field is set to No, the SECURITY.POSITON records are updated as per a normal non-transaction. Depending on the value in the above field, it is determined whether the SC.SETTLEMENT record is built in terms of nominal or no-nominal settlement on an actual basis. |
| Cust Act SuspCat | Records the category to which the customer entries are posted, until the actual settlement takes place. This field is editable only when Cash Hold Settle field is set to Yes and is defaulted from the associated field in the SC.PARAMETER application. The user can also change this category code at contract level. |
| Brok Act Susp Cat | Records the category to which counterparty entries are posted, until the actual settlement takes place. This field is editable only when the Cash Hold Settle field is set to Yes and is defaulted from the associated field in the SC.PARAMETER application. The user can also change this category code at contract level. |
| Misc Act Susp Cat | Records the category to which the charges (if any) are posted until the actual settlement takes place. This field is editable only when the Cash Hold Settle field is set to Yes and is defaulted from the associated field in the SC.PARAMETER application. The user can also change this category code at contract level. |
| Auto Cust Sett | Controls the automatic settlement of the nominal and cash for the customer. The value in this field is defaulted to Yes, If the Auto Cust Sett field is set to Yes in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application relating to the customer. The user can change this value to No at contract level, if required. |
| Auto Brok Sett | Controls the automatic settlement of the nominal and cash for the counterparty. The value in this field is defaulted to Yes, if the Auto Brok Sett field is set to Yes in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application relating to the counterparty. The user can change this value to No at contract level, if required. |

**InstrumentMaster**

| Field | Descriptions |
|---|---|
| Fund Inception | Holds the date of fund inception |
| Fund Issuer | Denotes the name of the fund issuer |
| Fund Advisor | Records advisors of the fund |
| Fund Sub-advisor | Records sub-advisors of the fund |
| Fund Manager | Records name of the fund managers |
| Registration Status | Indicates the countries where fund is registered |
| Trustee Name | Denotes the name of the trustee |
| Fund Classification | Defines any market categorisation or classification for the fund (based on investment objective, risk profile and so on) |
| Sub-Classification | Defines any sub-category or classification for the fund |
| Open or close ended | Denotes whether fund is open-ended or close-ended. The allowed values are OPEN and CLOSE. Open-ended funds allow the investor to invest anytime during the life of the fund, whereas the close ended funds allows the investor to invest only at the initial fund offer and does not allow the investor to redeem the fund until maturity. |
| Direct or Fund of Fund | Denotes whether it is a direct fund or a fund of fund. The allowed values are DIRECT and Fund of Funds (FOF). |
| Hedge Indicator | Denotes whether the fund is the hedge or not |
| Exchange Traded Fund | Denotes whether it is an exchange trade. The allowed values are YES and blank, where a blank field denotes non Exchange Traded Funds (ETF). |
| Derivatives Indicator | Indicates whether the fund uses derivatives as part of its investment or not. The allowed values are YES and NO. |
| Applicable Currencies | Defines the applicable currencies linked to the fund |
| Issue Size | Denotes the initial size in security currency |
| NFO Close Date | Denotes the initial fund offer closure date |
| Restriction | Allows the users to mention restrictions, if any |
| Closed To all | Denotes whether trading is not allowed. Allowed values are YES or NO |
| Closed To new | Denotes whether the fund is closed for new investors. Allowed values are YES or NO |
| Management Fee cap | Denotes the maximum stated management fee in percentage |
| Admin Fee Cap | Denotes the maximum stated admin fee in percentage |
| Currency related to minimum amount | Denotes the currency related to investment or redemption check file of CURRENCY |
| Amount of initial investment | Denotes the amount of initial investment |
| Amount of subsequent investment | Denotes the amount of subsequent investment |
| Minimum SIP amount | Denotes the minimum Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) amount |
| Minimum Redemption amount | Denotes the minimum redemption amount. This is an associated multi-value set from the Min Invt Ccy to Min Redem Amt fields. |
| 12M NAV High | Denotes the highest Net Asset Value (NAV) in last 12 months |
| 12M NAV Low | Denotes the lowest NAV in last 12 months |
| Subscription Start Date | Records the start date of subscription period. The hedge funds accept subscriptions on monthly basis, whereas, the others do on quarterly basis |
| Subscription End Date | Records the end date of the subscription period, which has to be filled along with the Subscription Start Date field |
| Redemption Start Date | Records the start date of the redemption period, whereas, some hedge funds allow redemption only during a certain period |
| Redemption End Date | Records the end date of the redemption period, which has to be filled along with the Redemption Start Date field |
| Minimum Holding Period | Denotes the allowed number of days the fund should be held before redemption or the number of notice days required for hedge funds |
| Minimum Holding Override | Indicates whether the minimum holding period can be overridden by paying a fee |
| Cool Cancel Period | Indicates the cooling or cancellation period, by when an investor can opt out of the contract |
| Switch Allowed | Indicates whether the switch is allowed for the fund and what type of switch is allowed. It is a multi-value field that accepts the values UNIT, AMOUNT, PERCENTAGE and ALL. |
| Unapproved | Denotes whether the fund is approved or not. If set to Yes, the fund is considered unapproved. If the field is blank, the fund is considered approved. Orders placed for unapproved funds are not allowed for grouping. |
| Wrap Eligible | Denotes whether fund is eligible for a wrap or not |
| Cut off time | Denotes the fund house cut-off time |
| Cut Off Time Zone | Denotes the time zone for the associated cut off time |
| Default Upfront | Triggers the defaulting upfront security. If set to YES, the upfront security from SC.PARAMETER is defaulted based on security currency and sub-asset type. |
| Entry Load | Indicates the entry load in terms of percentage |
| Exit Load | Indicates the exit load in terms of percentage |
| Switch Comm | Indicates the switching commission in terms of percentage. The switching commission is applicable on intra-fund switches and denotes the commission applicable while transferring from this fund. |
| Cool Cancel Period | Denotes the cooling period duration for the fund For example, if the cooling period is four days from the date of purchase of the fund, then the Cool Cancel Period field is populated with 4D. If an order is placed with the fund mentioned above and executed, the respective record in SEC.TRADE is created. Read SEC.TRADE section in trade creation for more information. |
| Entry Load Method | Identifies how the entry load is calculated and handled. There are different options as shown below: Bid Offer Bankpl The default method (if the field is blank) is BANKPL. This field is also available in the SC.STD.SEC.TRADE application for company level setting. The field at SECURITY.MASTER level overrides the company level setting. |
| Exit Load Method | Identifies how the exit load is calculated and handled. There are different options as shown below: Netamt Bid Offer The default method is Bid Offer. This field is also available in SC.STD.SEC.TRADE for a company level setting. The field at SECURITY.MASTER level overrides the company level setting. |
| Entry Rebate | Indicates the rebate (if any) on entry load in terms of percentage. The rebate is applicable only when the Entry Load Method is Bankpl. |
| Till Date | Indicates the date until when the rebate on entry load is applicable |
| Sub Amt Adj | Determines whether the customer’s investment (subscription amount) needs to be retained or reduced based on the rebate or discount offered, if rebate or discount is offered on the entry load. If this field is set to No or left blank, the original subscription amount is retained (by grossing up the investment amount) and the customer is debited for the same after applying the rebate (and channel discount) on entry load. If this field is set to Yes, the subscription amount is reduced in line with the rebate or channel discount. The field at SECURITY.MASTER level overrides the company level setting. |

| Valuation Subr | Controls the default valuation routine required to produce valuation reports |
| Local Stock Exch | Holds the ID of the stock exchange where the company usually trades. The ID of the local stock exchange is already defined in the STOCK.EXCHANGE application. |
| Bulk Limit | Allows the user to specify the number of transactions required before running a background bulk processing. For example, this field in SC.PARAMETER enables the user to enter hundreds of individual customer purchases or sales of securities and release the session while the transaction runs in the background. |
| Security Format | Enables the user to define the main ID for the record in the SECURITY.MASTER application, which holds the list of the various securities in which the organisation trades. The default format is (######-###). Example: The default format enables the user to define a security ID as 000001-000. This format supports the Telekurs security identification numbers. If Telekurs format is not required, the user can define any format using up to 12 characters. The user can use only the # and - characters in both the Telekurs and user-defined format where # indicates a numeric equivalent and – separates the suffix part of the ID. This field cannot be modified once the record in SC.PARAMETER is authorised. |
| Alternate Index | Enables the user to specify an alternative means of accessing individual security records for examination or entry into the transactions and enquiries. This field also enables the user to use other system IDs, such as the EUROCLEAR Clearance ID (if any), as well as the main ID. Usage of this field is no longer recommended. Instead, use the ALT.SEC.PARAMETER application. |

| Fields | Description |
|---|---|
| Synthetic Port | Indicates the synthetic portfolio used for parent child processing. This portfolio is updated in the customer side of parent transaction. |
| Synthetic Cpty | Indicates the synthetic counterparty used for parent child processing. The counterparty specified here is updated into broker side of child portfolio. |
| Synthetic Susp Cat | Used for parent child processing. The internal account category specified in this field is used for entry processing in parent and child trades. For parent and child trade, customer and broker side account is the internal account formed using this category. |
| Trade Creation | This field is set to Parent Child for creating parent child trades on execution |
| Authorise Child | If set to Yes, the child trades are authorised on authorisation of the parent. Child trades are also automatically authorised, if the Authorise Trade field in SC.EXE.SEC.ORDERS of the parent is set to Yes. |
| Upd Child Link | Determines whether the child link records such as SC.CHILD.ORDER.LINK and SC.CHILD.TRADE.LINK are to be updated. These backend files hold a link between the parent and child orders and trade. This is useful for reports and enquiries. |
| Parent Child Depo | Specifies whether parent trades are to be created based on each depository. The value is defaulted to the similar field in SC.EXE.SEC.ORDERS . |
| Bulklog Purge Days | Indicates the number of days to hold the purging of SC.BULK.EXCEPTION.LOG. The records with value date prior to the date calculated from the current date are purged. |
| Order Alloc Subr | Accepts an API that is used for the allocation of the executed nominal among different customers in the case of bulk orders. The arguments to an API are SEC.OPEN.ORDER record and SC.EXE.SEC.ORDERS record in dimensioned format. If the API is defined in the Order Alloc Subr field, the prorating process calls the local API to allocate the nominal for customers based on the API logic. |

**Trade Creation**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Customer No | Allows only those customers setup as customers in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application |
| Cust Trans Code | Helps the user to tell Temenos Transact if the customer is buying or selling the security, by entering the particular SC.TRANS.NAME applicable to buy or sell. If the user is not sure of the value, he can drill down to the SC.TRANS.NAME application to obtain the required transaction code. Then, the customer’s portfolio is updated. Temenos Transact always defaults to the first portfolio belonging to the customer. For example, a customer (1250) owning 1250-1 and 1250-75 portfolios always has the securities defaulted to portfolio 1250-1. If the user requires the securities held in or withdrawn from the other portfolio, it must be entered manually always. |
| Cu Account No | Specifies the identification of the customer’s financial account to be used to either obtain or pay the funds required. This field can be the subject of a very elaborate defaulting process (Read Portfolio Valuation for more information). The defaults are already setup and the user has to enter the key to view them if the user prefers to enter an alternative account that does not belong to that customer. For example , a customer is allowed to pay for securities using any preferred currency, so that the user can enter any financial account if it is pre-defined in the SEC.ACC.MASTER application. Temenos Transact uses the current forex rates to arrive at the amount of currency required but the user is able to type in own specified conversion rate, if required. The definition of an account not belonging to the portfolio customer causes an override during the opening or changing of a portfolio record. Also, when a particular transaction is designated to use another customer's account, any occurrence of that transaction also raises an override. |
| Cust Nominal | Indicates the number of share-type or quantity of nominal bond-type security the customer is buying or selling. Once the user enters the amount in this field, it is immediately validated to ensure that it complies with the trading units recorded in the underlying SECURITY.MASTER application’s Trading Units field. Therefore, the user must ensure that this amount is divisible by the trading unit and that it is equal to or greater than the trading unit. In case of unit trust and fund type securities, which can be traded in fractions, the Trading Units field must be set to zero to enable the user to process these particular types. |
| Cust Price | Specifies the the buy or sell price, that is, the price at which the trade is transacted. However there may be instances, especially when entering a large number of customer transactions (as in a bulk SEC.TRADE ) when the user may utilise a price defaulting procedure. |
| Customer Total Nominal, Cu Gross Am Sec, Customer Gross Amount | Indicates the total number of the security and the value of the transaction (before addition of other items such as tax, charges and interest) in both security and trade (settlement) currency. As the user progresses through the transaction and if the user validates the record, Temenos Transact automatically calculates various information. For example, post input of the price relative to the trade, the next three fields Customer Total Nominal, Cu Gross Am Sec, Customer Gross Amount Trade are populated depending upon the amount of the security traded and the price . As both the nominal and price fields are sub-values, the user can enter tranches of purchases or sales for the same customer portfolio. |

**Trade Creation**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Broker No | Identifies the broker with whom the organisation is arranging the security purchase or sale. The user can enter the basic customer mnemonic appertaining to the broker (if the user is aware of it). Then Temenos Transact performs an immediate validation to check if the chosen ID is a broker or counterpart. If not, the entered value is rejected by the validation process. |
| Broker Type | Confirms whether the role of the broker is entered in the Broker No field and is defaulted from the relevant record in CUSTOMER.SECURITY . This defaulting occurs ony when the underlying broker is setup to perform a single role. In those cases, where the broker may act in more than a single capacity, the user must inform the Temenos Transact about the precise role. |
| Broker Transaction Code | Specifies if the broker is buying or selling the security. As with the customer side of the SEC.TRADE , the user must enter into the Broker Transaction Code field, the required purchase or sale transaction from SC.TRANS.NAME . |
| Broker Acc No | Indicates the delivery details with regard to both the cash and security components of the transaction. It specifies the organisation’s Nostro over which the financial entries are to be posted. If required, payment can be effected over a Vostro account also. To affect a default, the user has to ensure that there is an existing record for the settlement currency on the NOSTRO.ACCOUNT application to be used by the Security application. If this is not the case, the user must enter any valid Nostro or Vostro account in the system, provided that the currency is similar to the settlement currency. For defaulting the broker account number from CUSTOMER.SECURITY application to the Broker Acc No field in the SEC.TRADE application, the system checks if the Br Sett Internal field is set to Yes. If this field is set to Yes, then the system defaults the cash or internal account (based on category) from the Br Set Acc field. If the system is unable to default an account in trade currency from Br Set Acc field, then the system displays the ‘Settlement account not found’ error. The user can manually enter the broker account or can update the record in CUSTOMER.SECURITY and re-input the transaction. |
| Broker Depo | Specifies the depository that the broker is using. The settlement method used decides whether this is a mandatory field or not. For example, if the user prefers to effect the settlement through Euroclear, the system must be able to build a valid formatted message type. Temenos Transact requires this information and displays a message, if this field is left blank. If it is not required, the user can leave the field blank. Although, Temenos Transact does not object, if the user prefers to specify the broker depository for the sake of valid information. If the user has to enter information in this field, for example, if Euroclear is used a valid depository must be entered. |
| Depository | This field in SEC.TRADE tells Temenos Transact a valid depository as defined in the CUSTOMER.SECURITY application where the organisation is to receive or deliver securities. The user can enter any valid record in CUSTOMER specifying the depository, which the broker is using. If the broker depository does not exist in the CUSTOMER application, the user can put the SEC.TRADE on hold and create a record in CUSTOMER. However, if the depository is barely used, the user may not prefer to open a record in CUSTOMER . So, in these instances Temenos Transact allows to type the depository name and address details using free format characters as required. |
| Broker Security Depository Account | Allows the broker account number by which it is identified at that same depository. This may default if the broker is using either Euroclear, Cedel, BNB or SEGA settlement systems and the broker’s account number is defined in the relative record in CUSTOMER.SECURITY . If the user is not using any of these particular depositories, enter any value to identify the broker’s account at the depot specified. |
| Broker Number Nominal | Specifies the amount of the security being purchased from or sold to the broker. This amount must comprise the total of the customer side of the transaction. This applies unless the user has arranged to accommodate the customer requirements using more than a single broker. In this case, the user must expand the fields and enter the second broker details in the same way as the first broker. On input, Temenos Transact validates the total from both sides of the transaction net out. |
| Broker Price | Specifies the price arranged with the broker. If the user wants to expand both the Broker Number Nominal and Broker Price fields, he can arrange the transaction in several tranches using different prices. |
| Broker Total Nominal, Broker Gross Amount Security and Broker Gross Amount Trade | Displays the total amount of the security arranged with the broker, the gross value of the security in security currency and the gross amount in the trade currency whether or not the transaction is for settlement in a different currency or not. The values in these fields are calculated based on the sum of the Broker Number Nominal multi-value fields for each broker. |
| Br Reallowance | Works exactly the same way as the identical two fields on the customer side of the transaction. If the user purchases securities through the broker on behalf of a customer, the entry of an amount reduces the overall amount the user has to pay to the broker. Therefore, if the user wants to add a re-allowance for a purchase, the user can use the leading - (minus) sign. If the user has arranged a sale to the broker, entry of an amount causes to be added to the overall proceeds. Therefore, the user should add a leading minus, if he prefers to reduce the overall precedes, which the organisation is to receive. |
| Broker Gross Accrued | Includes the consideration and any interest, if applicable. The Broker Gross Accrued field is a no-input system generated field, which illustrates the basic amount of the transaction and any interest (if applicable). Re-verify this field to ascertain that the trade proceeds prior to the addition or subtraction of any commissions, taxes, charges and other ad hoc amounts that affects the overall transaction proceeds |
| Broker Gross Amount Trade | Indicates the total contract value that includes any re-allowance. The user must be able to ascertain the effect of the chosen input into the re-allowance field. Until the user is used to this process, compare the value of the Broker Gross Accrued field to the value in the Broker Gross Amount Trade field. |
| Broker Interest Amount | Includes the Temenos Transact calculated interest amount relative to the nominal amount dealt with the broker, if the underlying security is an interest-bearing instrument. |
| Broker Fees Miscellaneous | Facilitates the user to prompt the system to add the interest if applicable by using the ENTER key. The process enables Temenos Transact to default the commission, foreign fees, stamp tax and if applicable, the Effectenboursenverein (EBV) related fees fields allowing the user to supply any ad hoc fees. The EBV fees are defaulted from the SC.BROK.STK.EXCH.FEES application. The user is free to move back to any field and either type in a different amount altogether or use the ENTER key over the field to remove the value. |
| Broker Commission | Indicates any commission relative to the trade. This is based on the rules contained within the relative STOCK.EXCHANGE application as defined in the Stock Exchange field in the beginning of the transaction. This in turn provides a link to one of the stock exchange calculation countries. For example, if the transaction is resolved through the Luxembourg Exchange, the STK.EXC.LU application contains the various commission rates. The user can overtype this amount with an entirely different amount, including zero, if necessary. |
| Broker Foreign Fee | Works similar to the Broker Commission field in which the user may overtype any fee defaulted by the system as set up on the underlying STOCK.EXCHANGE application. |
| Cl Commission | Enables the user to enter the required amount, if the user wants to enter a charge or commission amount in the event of updating a transaction on behalf of a customer only. Input is allowed only when the transaction includes a customer and is inhibited when the user is completing the current multi-value fields in respect of a broker or counterpart. |
| Broker Stamp Tax | This field value depends on is the value set up in the underlying STOCK.EXCHANGE application as with the Broker Commission and Broker Foreign Fee fields. The user may overtype whatever value is defaulted, if the user wants to change it. |
| Broker EBV Fees | This is a special field intended for those Temenos Transact users in Switzerland. However, the contents depend upon the rules as laid down in the STK.EXCH.LOCAL application relative to the organisation. As with the customer side of the transaction, the Broker Fees Miscellaneous field is added to accommodate those instances when the user may encounter any miscellaneous ad hoc fees that cannot be readily set up in the STOCK.EXCHANGE application . If the user has defined in SC.STD.SEC.TRADE for demarcating and allocation of the treasury profit to the originating branch, the user is required to input the treasury price in the SEC.TRADE , which is again optional. In the absence of which, the system posts the difference between the Broker Price and Cust Price to the Market Pl Cat stated therein in SC.STD.SEC.TRADE application. Upon input, the difference between the treasury price and broker price is posted to the respective market P/L category defined in SC.STD.SEC.TRADE application. Any difference between the treasury price and customer price is posted to the respective treasury P/L category as defined in the SC.STD.SEC.TRADE application. |
| Broker Net Amount Trade | Displays the net contract value for the broker in the trade currency. This amount is made up of all components (commissions, taxes and so on) in respect of the broker and represents the amount to be paid or received from that broker. |
| Broker Account Currency | Calculates the contents of the settlement amount in the Broker Account Currency field. The previous Broker Account Currency field BR.ACCOUNT.CCY confirms only the currency of the brokers’ cash account over which they have requested settlement defined by the user or by default in the Broker Acc No field. Unlike customers who can pay for their securities using any currency they wish, Temenos Transact does not allow the broker to be paid in any currency other than the security currency. |
| Broker Deliver Instruction | This field value must comprise a valid SC.DEL.INSTR application component, but defaulting can occur or the user can enter a valid choice of his own. This field is similar to the Customer Delivery Instruction field except the broker requirement specified. The user is not able to affect a delivery against payment instruction if the user and broker depot differ. The values entered here also affect the Temenos Transact SEC.DEL.CONTROL application, which expects only the security movements, if the transaction is free of payment but both cash and securities are dealt on an against payment basis. The various validation rules are obtained using the rules specified in each SC.DEL.INSTR application. These instructions form a part of the message formats when building SWIFT type messages for use when settling through Euroclear, Cedel and other automated settlement facilities. |
| Advice Default | The Advice Default field in the SC.PARAMETER application controls the default for all other YES or NO fields in the application. If the user prefers to suppress instructions or advice to the customers, brokers, depositories or any combinations thereof, they can do so by populating the YES or NO fields, as shown in the below screenshot. |
| Broker Beneficiary Bank | This field displays the beneficiary bank which is to be used for the payment or receipt of the Broker amount due. This applies only when the broker does not maintain account facilities at the organisation. If there is no default, this is obtained from the AGENCY application, and the user can enter a valid customer to identify the beneficiary bank. If this is not set up in the customer database, the user has a choice of putting the transaction on hold and creating the required record and relating the AGENCY details or the user may prefer to type the bank name and address instead. |
| Broker Beneficiary 2 | This field helps the user to enter a valid customer ID to identify the second bank in situations when the user must utilise a second beneficiary bank in order to properly effect the required payment to the broker. |
| Broker Beneficiary Address | This field helps the user who is preparing a settlement to a lesser used bank and does not want to set up CUSTOMER and AGENCY records to enter the details into a set of multi-value fields. Here, the user must enter both name and full address of the respective bank. These fields are complex as there are in-built controls designed to protect the user from erroneous input. Wherever possible, users are advised to ensure that the database includes all the banks that they are likely to encounter along with the relevant AGENCY details, thereby ensuring that Temenos Transact can help to eliminate the need to enter repetitive settlement details. Another way to ensure that broker settlement details are defaulted correctly in SEC.TRADE is to set up the SC.SETT.INSTRUCT application to record the Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI) of the broker. Then, the system automatically defaults the various fields pertaining to the broker. |

**Trade Creation**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| To Contra Ref | Specifies whether the trade entered is contra to an existing transaction and the transaction reference of the original trade. |
| Contra By Ref | Specifies the transaction reference of the contra trade on the original transaction. |
| Exch Rate Sec | In a contra transaction, this is an input field and the user can amend the default rate to a rate applicable to the original transaction. |

**Trade Creation**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Stamp Indicator | Defaults from SC.SETT.INSTRUCT based on the transaction code of broker, but can be manually overridden. The value must be in AAAA/BBBB or BBBB format. The value is mapped to 22F Tag and the Stamp Duty indicator in sequence E of MT54X(X = 0 to 3). This is a free format field and validation is not done. |
| Sparty Narr Qual | Qualifier pertaining to narrative in 70a Tag of SETPRTY block in MT540 to MT543. |
| Sprty Narrative | This free format narrative is mapped to 70a Tag of SETPRTY block in MT540 to MT543. If narrative is entered with DECL qualifier, it is mapped to 70E Tag in SETPRTY block. If narrative is entered with PART or REGI qualifier, it is mapped to 70D Tag in SETPRTY block. If narrative is entered with PACO qualifier, it is mapped to 70C Tag in SETPRTY block. |
| Bene Owner | The user can enter a beneficial owner and this is mapped to 22F Tag qualifier BENE in SETDET block. The value must be entered as per SWIFT guidelines. |
| Buyr Nation | The user can enter a valid country code of the buyer and this is mapped to 95C tag in the qualifier INVE of OTHRPRTY block. |

**Trade Creation**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Cu Wht Perc | Signifies the tax rate applicable as defaulted from the tax rate in the TAX application. The tax rate in the Cu Wht Perc field defaults from the TAX.TYPE.CONDITION application. |
| Customer Withhold Tax | Indicates the amount after computing the tax value based on the tax rate in the Cu Wht Perc field and the amount. The net amount trade is computed after deducting the WHT, if any. |
| Wht Tax Code | The Wht Tax Code defaults from the Share Tax or Bond Tax field from TXN.TAX.CODE , if the security code is share or bond, respectively. |
| Cu Wht Perc, Cu Wht Tax and Wht Tax Code | The fields in ORDER.BY.CUST, SEC.OPEN.ORDER, SC.EXE.SEC.ORDERS and SEC.TRADE indicate the amount of taxation in trade currency. A linked tax is applied on this amount. |
| Cu Net Am Trd | The deduction amount is included in the amount defined in this field in each of these applications. |
| Cu Gross Am Trd or Cu Gross Accr | The value is used as the base amount depending on the accrued interest. This is indicated in the Amt Base field in TXN.TAX.CODE . |

**TransactionFees Charges Taxes**

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Security Type | Holds a valid record in SECURITY.MASTER , ASSET.TYPE , or SUB.ASSET.TYPE |
| Domicile | Holds a valid country code or ALL. Value of this field is mapped with the Domicile field in the SECURITY.MASTER application. |
| Stock Exchange | Holds a valid STOCK.EXCHANGE ID or ALL. The user can enter the value for either domicile or stock exchange. It is not logical to enter both the values |
| Transaction Type | Holds a valid transaction type for BUY or SELL or ALL |
| Index | This is a no input field. Defaults the value based on the following combination. Security Type*Stock Exchange*Domicile*Transaction Type |

|---|---|

SUPPRESS.ACCOUNTING field is set to ‘Yes’ to suppress any GL accounting performed against the Limit records under the Limit product. This field accepts the input when the Limit record has nothing set in the Reference Child field. When the THIRD.PARTY.EXPOSURE field set to ‘Yes’, it marks the given Limit records under the Limit product to hold the third party exposure for their Customer(s).
